description: This Java class defines a custom JSP tag OrderProductDownloadUrlTag that generates a download URL for a product within an order, based on merchant store data and order details.

classes.name: OrderProductDownloadUrlTag
classes.description: Custom JSP tag class for generating download URLs for order products based on store and order data.

methods.name: doStartTag
methods.description: Generates the download URL for an order product and writes it out in the JSP page.

methods.name: getProductDownload
methods.description: Getter for the product download details.

methods.name: setProductDownload
methods.description: Setter for the product download details.
